description: 131-subcircuit labels build rollout samples, train a CUDA checkpoint, plan and evaluate final TC.
Reuse one oracle_actions.tsv to compare checkpoints without backend resampling noise.
Apply exact candidate allowlist before planning and audit all budgeted nodes as legal.
Label or allowlist node is absent from parsed graph; reject rather than silently substitute.
Candidate allowlist is empty; planner must fail before producing a zero-length success artifact.
Planner cannot meet strict budget without duplicates; report infeasible instead of changing budget.
Final circuit or alias appears in training labels or oracle groups.
Repeated planner tuning on final circuits converts them into a development set.
Research artifacts are pushed without explicit user approval.
Multiple GPU workers append the same TSV or update best.json concurrently.
Global caches retain prior circuit nodes or priors when switching benchmarks.
Two training variants share run_dir and overwrite latest.pt/history.csv.
Predicted z is fed back for hundreds of greedy steps although training horizon is at most five.
Feature SCOAP update says a state improved while the real patched netlist behaves differently.
Candidate context or cluster data is not recomputed after selected actions change.
Per-candidate full-graph scoring times hundreds of steps becomes the dominant cost.
Increasing recall from 48 to 192 changes runtime and pool-relative score calibration.
Unscoped test/file discovery scans hundreds of thousands of generated files.
Atalanta/TMAX times out after plan generation; retain plan/log and mark result incomplete.
Training/planning must request GPU access, not silently fall back to CPU.
results.tsv contains failed rows plus successful retries; aggregation must filter status and deduplicate.
Untrusted output paths escape the intended project/artifact directory.
Resume executes an unscreened command stored in state or handoff JSON.
Generated docs include environment credentials or private URLs verbatim.
Comparison uses baseline/reference TC instead of DeepTPI final TC.
EPFL PI/PO layout differs from the exact version used to build DeepTPI NPZ.
Plan node/type converts to a different backend candidate or invalid test point.
Config points to absent /data3 labels while current data lives under /data4.
Many equal ΔTC actions make pairwise rank count sparse or unstable.
Oracle subset overrepresents negative actions and distorts deployment ranking.
Multiple current-best files use different baselines, legality rules or comparison columns.
User cannot distinguish slow planner progress from a stalled job.
Unknown or mistyped JSON fields silently fall back to defaults.
Resume should reuse completed circuit outputs without accepting truncated plans.
Discard code change without deleting user artifacts or unrelated dirty worktree changes.
Cleanup must not remove evidence before final labels and logs are durably written.
